an8.24:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Āḷaviyaṃ viharati Aggāḷave cetiye.
an8.24:1.2: Atha kho Hatthako Āḷavako pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Hatthakaṃ Āḷavakaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an8.24:1.4: kathaṃ pana tvaṃ Hatthaka imaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgaṇhāsī ti?
an8.24:1.5: Yān' imāni bhante Bhagavatā desitāni cattāri saṃgahavatthūni, tehāhaṃ imaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgaṇhāmi.
an8.24:1.7: ‘ayaṃ dānena saṃgahetabbo' ti, taṃ dānena saṃgaṇhāmi;
an8.24:1.9: ‘ayaṃ peyyavajjena saṃgahetabbo' ti, taṃ peyyavajjena saṃgaṇhāmi;
an8.24:1.11: ‘ayaṃ atthacariyāya saṃgahetabbo' ti, taṃ atthacariyāya saṃgaṇhāmi;
an8.24:1.13: ‘ayaṃ samānattatāya saṃgahetabbo' ti, taṃ samānattatāya saṃgaṇhāmi.
an8.24:1.14: Saṃvijjante kho pana me bhante kule bhogā,
an8.24:1.15: daliddassa kho no tathā sotabbaṃ maññantī ti. 3.
an8.24:1.17: yoni kho tyāhaṃ Hatthaka mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgahetuṃ.
an8.24:1.18: Ye hi keci Hatthaka atītamaddhānaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgahesuṃ, sabbe te imeh' eva catūhi saṃgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgahesuṃ;
an8.24:1.19: ye pi hi keci Hatthaka anāgatamaddhānaṃ mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgaṇhissanti, sabbe te imeh' eva catūhi saṃgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgaṇhissanti;
an8.24:1.20: ye pi hi keci Hatthaka etarahi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgaṇhanti, sabbe te imeh' eva catūhi saṃgahavatthūhi mahatiṃ parisaṃ saṃgaṇhantī ti. 4.
an8.24:2.1: Atha kho Hatthako Āḷavako Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an8.24:2.2: Atha kho Bhagavā acirapakkante Hatthake Āḷavake bhikkhū āmantesi:-- 5.
an8.24:2.3: Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ Hatthakaṃ Āḷavakaṃ dhāretha.
an8.24:2.8: bhikkhave Hatthako Āḷavako, ottāpī bhikkhave Hatthako Āḷavako,
an8.24:2.13: Imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ Hatthakaṃ Āḷavakaṃ dhārethā
